summary: Create one DartPoints Holding Company, LLC record. NOVA Infrastructure Fund II acquired control on April 24, 2025; Astra retained a minority interest after selling control, and Orion Infrastructure Capital added minority equity alongside its debt investment. No later platform ownership transfer was found, and acquired brands, individual sites, real estate and financing SPVs remain beneath the platform.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact owner percentages and legal acquisition or top-company vehicles are not publicly disclosed.
The identity and disposition of the 11 legacy 2015 investors and any founder or management rollover are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedActions: Create one canonical DartPoints Holding Company, LLC company.
Add NOVA Infrastructure Fund II as the active controlling owner from April 24, 2025.
Add Astra Capital Management as a continuing minority owner, preserving its May 2020 control entry and April 2025 partial sell-down.
Add Orion Infrastructure Capital as a current minority-equity owner from April 24, 2025 while keeping its senior debt role distinct.
Do not create separate PortCos for Metro Data Centers, Immedion, Venyu, Lexington, other sites, real estate entities or financing SPVs.
